List project refunds#

get/v1/projects/{id}/refunds

Requires conversion.list. Returns paginated refund records.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório

Parâmetros de consulta

startDatestring
endDatestring
pageinteger

Padrão: 1

limitinteger

Padrão: 50

filtersstring
Exemplo
curl -X GET "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/refunds" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
Respostas
200object

Successful response.

Get a project refund#

get/v1/projects/{id}/refunds/{refundId}

Requires conversion.read. Returns the stored conversion ID, including the nil UUID for an unlinked refund.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório
refundIdstring (uuid)obrigatório
Exemplo
curl -X GET "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/refunds/{refundId}" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
Respostas

Successful response.
